note: TITAN Noir Pro (H0062, Product_dianahypro): the overseas X50 Ultra on the same XGIMI firmware line (gsi-research/H0062_TITAN_NOIR.md). Its stock settings tree is newsettings settings_tree_product_dianahypro (res/2s.json, the same nodes in V1.2.54, V1.2.99 and the X50 1.2.64 build, V1.2.99 adds only color_uniformity_adjustment). Every row follows that tree (owner 2026-11-13: show what stock has). Against the X50 tree: its own picture mode list (standard 35, movie 29, sport 9, Filmmaker 27, ISF day 38, ISF night 39, performance 5 behind the stock overheating warning, no AI, soft, colour accuracy, office or HDR Vivid: ModelMenu.TITAN; IMAX enhanced and the Dolby modes are content-only nodes, left out as on the X50), the same eye protection page (more_eye_state: off / follow / be at ease), the same game menu, projection, keystone and sound pages. Light rows as this model's stock has them (X50Projector StockLight, evidence in devices/g0111/research/LIGHT_ROWS_STOCK.md): light source level 1..10 (DisplayManager 6/7, the Boost read 152, no Boost step: the boost setter 151 is not allowed, a Boost set in stock stays and the slider refuses). Iris (stock node picture_iris_ring_adjustment_diana, first row of the stock image page under the light level): dynamic, f/2.0, f/3.0, f/4.0, f/5.5, f/7.0 in the stock order on GmTvManager 199/200 (values 0 dynamic, 20, 30, 40, 55, 70). While it reads dynamic, f/5.5 or f/7.0 the light level is refused with the stock note (IrisRule), the iris is refused in the office and performance picture modes (stock SettingMutexManager). Dynamic black (172/174), never in the PC, office or HDR Vivid picture mode. The family picture rows of the stock picture page (X50Projector ProPictureHal, stock calls in devices/g0111/research/allowed_x50projector.tsv): colour temperature standard / movie / D65 (DisplayManager 4/5 as stock choiceLedMode, refused in the office mode), colour optimisation, gamma (the content's own curve or manual) with its manual value 1.8..2.6, HDR dynamic tone mapping (HDR10 only, never in IMAX), local contrast, noise reduction, reset this picture mode and reset all after the stock question, colour optimisation and local contrast hidden while HDR plays (stock PictureFactory). The senior colour row of the stock General page (GmTvManager 179..182, refused in the office, performance and colour accuracy modes). Not ported yet: the rainbow reduction modes (picture_anti_rbe_entrance), idle auto shutdown, colour uniformity (V1.2.99), the HDBaseT signal page. Eye-protection safety stays in X50EyeGuard, the menu only sends the stock user-row calls. 3D: the six modes of the stock tree (image_3d_info_state: close, lr, tb, lrTo2d, tbTo2d, frame_packing, the X50 tree's node), the X50 calls (DisplayManager 22 enable3D, 23 enable3DTo2D, read back by 24 / 25) behind the stock refusal list (X50Projector X50ThreeD), so the 3D tile takes the network place and network goes to the top row. The rows of rs30-parity-system, rs30-parity-system2, cec-core and rs30-parity-projection as on the X50 Ultra: the stock dianahypro tree has the same nodes (lens_memory, picture_screen_rotation, remote_focus_img_guide, sound_strong_effect, sound_volume_balance, voice_key_tone, signal_setting_control_cec, signal_source_setting_auto, sys_tempe, more_vision_optimization in newsettings release_838 settings_tree_product_dianahypro.json). The rows of x50-parity-gaps and rs30-parity-picture2 as on the X50 Ultra (motion compensation, gamut native / BT.2020 / DCI-P3 / BT.709, AI contrast, super resolution, rainbow reduction, the HDMI aspect ratio, the stock picture page rule, white balance with its 2-point and 11-point pages, colour correction, the HDR enhancement and Dolby Vision screen pages, the auto mode switch, the style filter's way back): the dianahypro tree has the same nodes (image_mode_motion_compensation_v4, picture_gamut_diana, image_ai_contrast, picture_super_resolution_switch, picture_anti_rbe, image_ratio_info, color_correction, picture_hdr_enhancement, picture_dolby_curtain, image_set_mode_auto_switch, picture_3d_lut_bt). Motion compensation without the original frame: the TITAN feature.xml has no real_cinema_mode, so stock sends setOutputTiming(6) first, not ported. Rainbow reduction stays one switch (the standard / enhanced choice under picture_anti_rbe_entrance is not ported).
